text.body: || atha rāmāṣṭakam || sugrīvamitraṃ paramaṃ pavitraṃ sītākalatraṃ navameghagātram | kāruṇya pātraṃ śatapatranetraṃ śrīrāmacandraṃ satataṃ namāmi || 1|| saṃsārasāraṃ nigamaṃ pracāraṃ dharmāvatāraṃ hata bhūmi bhāram | sadā nirvikāraṃ sukha sindhusāraṃ śrīrāmacandraṃ satataṃ namāmi || 2|| lakṣmī vilāsaṃ jagatāṃ nivāsaṃ bhūdeva vāsaṃ sukha sindhu hāsam | laṅkā vināśaṃ bhavanaṃ prakāśaṃ śrīrāmacandraṃ satataṃ namāmi || 3|| maṃdāramālaṃ vacane rasālaṃ guṇayaṃ viśalaṃ hata saptatālam | kravyādakālaṃ suralokapālaṃ śrīrāmacandraṃ satataṃ namāmi || 4|| vedāṃta jñānaṃ sakala satānaṃ haṃtāramānaṃ tridaśaṃ pradhānam | gajendrapālaṃ vigatā viśālaṃ śrīrāmacandraṃ satataṃ namāmi || 5|| khelā'tibhītaṃ svajane punītaṃ syāmo pragītaṃ vacane ahītam | rāgenagītaṃ vacane ahītaṃ śrīrāmacandraṃ satataṃ namāmi || 6|| līlāśarīraṃ raṇaraṅga dhīraṃ viśvai kavīraṃ raghuvaṃśadhāram | gambhīranādaṃ jitasarvavādaṃ śrīrāmacandraṃ satataṃ namāmi || 7|| śyāmābhirāmaṃ nayanābhirāmaṃ guṇābhirāmaṃ vacanābhirāmaṃ | viśvapraṇāmaṃ katabhaktikāmaṃ śrīrāmacandraṃ satataṃ namāmi || 8|| || iti rāmāṣṭakaṃ sampūrṇam ||
